subject: How to specify the way to deal with NA in mediation in lavaan + negative variances

messages.author: dd8507309f8545e1
messages.subject: How to specify the way to deal with NA in mediation in lavaan + negative variances
parts:
Hi,

After having runned SEM analyses with a model, I tried to run on the same dataset and with  the same variables a mediation model.
How to specifiy I want to include observations even when they have NA

I tried using "missing= FIML", but several problems appear :


model1.mediations <- '    # definitions
                          metacog       =~ zmem_addinv + zatt_addinv + zlang_addinv + zexec_addinv
                          insight       =~ BIRCHW_cor + -1* SUMD_cor
                          functioning   =~ EGF_cor + PSP_

                          # direct effect
                          functioning  ~ c*metacog
                         
                          # mediator
                          insight      ~ a* metacog
                          functioning  ~ b* insight
                         
                          # indirect effect
                          ab := a*b
                         
                          # total effect
                          total := c + (a*b)

                                    '

fit <- sem(model1.mediations, data = f , missing = "FIML" , std.lv =T , se="boot", bootstrap = 100) Messages d'avis : 1: Dans lav_data_full(data = data, group = group, cluster = cluster, : lavaan WARNING: some cases are empty and will be ignored: 69 98 116 133 157 293 326 399 404 416 462 465 485 508 527 530 535 576 683 688 725 783 789 809 815 843 865 882 922 946 950 960 977 983 1033 1098 1119 1137 1163 1165 1175 1176 1240 2: Dans lav_model_nvcov_bootstrap(lavmodel = lavmodel, lavsamplestats = lavsamplestats, : lavaan WARNING: 93 bootstrap runs failed or did not converge. 3: Dans lav_model_nvcov_bootstrap(lavmodel = lavmodel, lavsamplestats = lavsamplestats, : lavaan WARNING: 3 bootstrap runs resulted in nonadmissible solutions. 4: Dans lav_model_vcov(lavmodel = lavmodel, lavsamplestats = lavsamplestats, : lavaan WARNING: The variance-covariance matrix of the estimated parameters (vcov) does not appear to be positive definite! The smallest eigenvalue (= -1.002985e-17) is smaller than zero. This may be a symptom that the model is not identified. 5: Dans lav_object_post_check(object) : lavaan WARNING: some estimated ov variances are negative



Thanks a lot for your help

messages.author: bc810b1d0900407f
messages.subject: Re: How to specify the way to deal with NA in mediation in lavaan + negative variances
parts: This message only tells you cases removed due to "empty" (no data). You ca safely ignored them unless you know they should not be excluded.

> 2: Dans lav_model_nvcov_bootstrap(lavmodel = lavmodel, lavsamplestats = lavsamplestats, : lavaan WARNING: 93 bootstrap runs failed or did not converge.
> 3: Dans lav_model_nvcov_bootstrap(lavmodel = lavmodel, lavsamplestats = lavsamplestats, : lavaan WARNING: 3 bootstrap runs resulted in nonadmissible solutions.

*Usually*, these two warnings can also be ignored because convergence problem and nonadmissible solutions can occur purely by chance, *but* ...

I found that you set 'bootstrap = 100'. So, having 93 out of 100 failed to converge *is* a problem.

> 4: Dans lav_model_vcov(lavmodel = lavmodel, lavsamplestats = lavsamplestats, : lavaan WARNING: The variance-covariance matrix of the estimated parameters (vcov) does not appear to be positive definite! The smallest eigenvalue (= -1.002985e-17) is smaller than zero. This may be a symptom that the model is not identified.
> 5: Dans lav_object_post_check(object) : lavaan WARNING: some estimated ov variances are negative

How about removing 'se="boot", bootstrap = 100' and fit the model again? If the problem is really due to the model, not due to bootstrapping, then you should see the last two warnings again. Fix these two warnings first before asking for bootstrap CIs because they suggest something's wrong with the model.

My two cents.

-- Shu Fai

messages.author: 38226bd700051927
messages.subject: Re: How to specify the way to deal with NA in mediation in lavaan + negative variances
parts:
You have a warning message that "The variance-covariance matrix of the estimated parameters (vcov) does not appear to be positive definite! The smallest eigenvalue (= -1.002985e-17) is smaller than zero. This may be a symptom that the model is not identified."

For what I can see, the measurement model for `functioning` seems to be underidentified. You are constraining the latent variables to be standardized, so their loading on their respective first indicator is a free parameter. With only two items, you need to either constrain one of them to a fixed value, or both loadings to be equal. You'll probably need to consider which of these constraints makes more sense theoretically for you.

--
Daniel Morillo, Ph.D.
